arrivalScene: A hide lean-to. A cairn of trade trinkets under a horned skull. Plain lilies at the water. Laid edge to edge, the six pieces make one map, and its line runs away from every road.
embarkResult: You water the beasts, check every lashing, and ride out along the line.
returnResult: Not yet. The oasis will keep. You turn back for Westmark.

finalCards.title: Open sand
finalCards.line: The hours pass with nothing in them.

finalCards.title: The same sand
finalCards.line: The line under the pieces does not change.

finalCards.title: Still moving
finalCards.line: Nothing on this stretch asks for a name.
